'''Kragan Gorr's shuttle''' was a unique [[shuttle]] made from scavenged [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] parts by the [[pirate]] organization known as the [[Warbird gang]]. In [[34 ABY]], the shuttle served as the personal [[transport]] of the pirate leader, [[Kragan Gorr]], and used during several raids against the [[Supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. Some time later the shuttle was kept inside the ''Colossus'' after the pirates were betrayed by the [[First Order]] and were given shelter by [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]].

After the Warbird gang attempted a mutiny and were expelled from the ''Colossus'', the shuttle was kept inside the ''Colossus'' and was later used, in [[35 ABY]], by former pirate [[Synara San]] in the defense of the ''Colossus'' against the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]], ''[[Thunderer]]'', in a battle in the [[Barabesh system]].

==Description==
A unique [[shuttle]], that served as the personal shuttle of the [[pirate]] leader [[Kragan Gorr]], was made by the [[Warbird gang]] from scavenged [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] parts.<ref name="USWNE" /> The shuttle counted with eight [[Engine|thrusters]],<ref name="The Escape" /> alongside a complement of [[laser cannon]]s and [[ion cannon]]s that were demanding to the [[starship]]'s power. The shuttle was also maneuverable in-atmosphere, but it had minimal [[Deflector shield generator|shields]] and an unreliable [[hyperdrive]]. Despite unreliable characteristics, the ship had an ample cargo space used by the pirates for any stolen loot.<ref name="USWNE" />

==History==
===Raiding the ''Colossus''===
[[File:KraganGorrShuttle-TheTripleDark.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kragan Gorr's shuttle during the first raid on the ''Colossus''.]]
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}} establishes that the events of [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One]], which includes this episode, takes place thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to [[34 ABY]], according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> the shuttle took part in two raids against the [[Supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. Looking to occupy the ''Colossus'', the [[First Order]] employed the Warbird gang to attack the station, hoping [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]], the owner of the ''Colossus'', would join the First Order. During the [[Attack on the Colossus|first raid]], [[Synara San]] piloted Gorr's shuttle. Inside the shuttle, Gorr gave out orders to his fellow pirates, but after [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] broadcasted an unpleasant feedback over the pirates' frequency, Gorr ordered the retreat.<ref name="Triple Dark" />

In the [[Raid on the Colossus|second raid]], Kragan Gorr used the shuttle as escape transport, after he saw they had done enough damage towards the ''Colossus''. During their escape, the shuttle was being piloted by [[Nikto]] pirate [[Leoz]].<ref name="Synara Score">{{Resistance|Synara's Score}}</ref>

===Helping the ''Colossus''===
[[File:KraganShuttle-TheEscape.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kragan Gorr's shuttle, piloted by Synara San, during the skirmish in the Barabesh system.]]
When the First Order ended their partnership and betrayed them, the pirates helped Doza and the ''Colossus'' escape from [[Castilon]]. Once safe, the pirates accompanied the ''Colossus'' on their journey.<ref name="No Escape">{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}}</ref> During their travels, the pirates kept the shuttle parked inside their [[hangar]] alongside the ''[[Galleon]]''.<ref name="Salvage Run">{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}}</ref> After the pirates attempted a [[Mutiny on the Colossus|mutiny]], they were expelled from the ''Colossus'', and their shuttle was left behind and kept inside the former pirate hangar.<ref name="The Mutiny">{{Resistance|The Mutiny}}</ref>

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date 2">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' states that the rescue of [[Tamara Ryvora]] took place fifty-four [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the rescue must have taken place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> Synara San used the shuttle<ref name="SW Battles" /> when [[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']] [[Battle of Barabesh|attacked]] the ''[[Thunderer]]'', a First Order [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]], in the [[Barabesh system]], which was where [[Tamara Ryvora]], Kazuda Xiono and [[Jarek Yeager]] were trapped. The shuttle alongside [[starfighter]]s from [[Ace Squadron|Ace]] and [[Jade Squadron]] managed to destroy the [[Star Destroyer]] and rescue their friends.<ref name="The Escape" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kragan Gorr's shuttle first appeared in "[[The Triple Dark]],"<ref name="Triple Dark" /> the third episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[October 14]], [[2018]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> Concept art of Kragan Gorr's shuttle, titled "shipSynara," was created for the episode by [[Chris Glenn]], and was shown in the Bucket's List Extra article on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Bucket List">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-buckets-list-extra-the-triple-dark|text=Bucket's List Extra: 9 Fun Facts from "The Triple Dark" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}}</ref>
